Advt. No: CSJMU/P&C/90-09-24 Date- 19/09/2024
Advertisement Notification for recruitement of Junior Research Assistant (JRA)/ Senior Research Assistant
(SRA) / Research Associate (RA) in CSTUP Projects (on contract) purely tempory basis (Two Posts)
Applications are invited for two posts of “Junior Research Assistant (JRA)/ Senior Research Assistant (SRA)/
Research Associate (RA)” at a fixed fellowship of Rs.25000 per month initially for a one year and can be extended
upto three years and payable as per rules laid by Council of Science and Technology (CST), UP. Details of the
projects are given below:
Name of Principal
Investigator
Title of Project & Sanction order number Positions
Dr Anuradha Kalani
Associate Professor
Management of Diabetic Kidney Disease
through Carnosine Synthase and mir-3473b"
(Project ID: 3838; CST/D-733)
Junior Research Assistant (JRA)*
(One Post)
Dr Rajeev Mishra
Associate Professor
The role of telomere in regulating stem cell
phenotype in triple-negative breast cancer.
(Project ID: 3863; CST/D-907)
Senior Research Assistant (SRA) /
Research Associate (RA)*
(One post)
*Note: Candidate interested to register for Ph.D. position at CSJMU, Kanpur Uttar Pradesh 208024 will be given
preference.
**Eligibility criteria for selection of J.R.A./S.R.A./R.A.
1. Only Indian citizens who are resident of Uttar Pradesh are eligible for Research Assistantship/ Associateship in the
research projects funded by CST UP.
JUNIOR RESEARCH ASSISTANT
i. Junior Research Assistantship (JRF) may be awarded to "'holders of M.Sc. in relevant discipline.
ii. High academic attainment with 1st class throughout all academic credentials
iii. The upper age limit for a Junior Research Assistant shall be below 28 years as on 01.04.2024.
SENIOR RESEARCH ASSISTANT
i. Senior Research Assistantship (SRA) may be awarded to holders of M.Sc. in relevant discipline with high academic
attainment and at least two years research experience after M. Sc. as evident from the published papers in reputed
Journals
ii. The upper age limit for Senior Research Assistant shall be 32 years as on 01.04.2024.
RESEARCH ASSOCIATE
i. Persons possessing minimum Ph.D. in relevant discipline with three years’ research, design and development
experience will be eligible for consideration for appointment as Research Associate.

General Terms and Conditions:
1. The position is purely temporary and is coterminous with the project.
2. The selection committee has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates to be called for the interview
to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed in the
advertisement. The decision of the selction committee will be final.
3. Filled scan copy of application can be submitted to the respective PIs at anukalani@csjmu.ac.in (Dr
Anuradha Kalani) or rajeevm@csjmu.ac.in (Dr Rajeev Mishra) on or before September 30, 2024. No online
application will be entertained after the deadline.
4. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated via email or through University website after 30 September 2024.
Candiates are advised to visit the University website regularly for any updates.
5. Original certificates and self-attested copies of all certificates along with the application form including
recent domicile certificate (issued within 6 months) need to be presented at the time of interview.
6. The candidate is expected to join immediately, if selected.
7. Organizing institution reserves the right to make changes to the terms and conditions without prior notice.
Any dispute or claim shall be settled in accordance with the organizing institution's terms and conditions All
decisions made by the Head of the institution shall be final. The organizing institution shall not be held liable
or responsible for any claims or losses.
8. In case candidate resigns from the slected post, he/she needs to provide one month prior notice and obtain
NOC for relase of last month fellowship.
9. Postions are completely temporary basis and can be terminated without any prior notice
10. No TA/DA will be paid, if called for interview.
For any query email can be addressed at:
Dr Anuradha Kalani
Associate Professor
School of Life Sciences & Biotechnology
Email: anukalani@csjmu.ac.in
Dr Rajeev Mishra
Associate Professor
School of Life Sciences & Biotechnology
Email: rajeevm@csjmu.ac.in
